fuel_consumption.source_quote: Estimated 2005 fuel consumption ~96 million gallons per item7a (implied from item7a coverage percentages and item8 notes disclosures).

instrument_type_details.notes: Fuel hedge collars on jet fuel as cash flow hedges under SFAS 133. Coverage for 2006: Q1=29.6% (floor $1.71/ceiling $1.85/gal Gulf Coast Mean +~$0.20 into-plane); Q2=21.1% (floor $1.83/ceiling $1.98/gal); Q3=16.8% (floor $1.87/ceiling $2.01/gal); Q4=9.9% (floor $1.87/ceiling $2.02/gal). Weighted avg ~19.4% of 2006 estimated fuel consumption. In 2005 realized $5.1M income from fuel above ceiling. At Dec 31, 2005: $0.2M liability recorded in accrued liabilities. Effective FV changes in OCI.

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel, oil and associated taxes increased $69.7 million, or 64.3%, from 2004 to $178.1 million in 2005. Into-plane fuel prices increased 37.7% in 2005, averaging $1.86 per gallon in 2005 versus $1.35 per gallon in 2004. [Derived: $178.1M / $1.86 = 95.8M gallons; fuel consumption increase = $20.9M unfavorable]
